slice: Slice 5 PR-A (backend narrative field) round 2 verify
allowed_commands: dotnet build RunCoach.slnx --no-restore with the in-process flag bundle from AGENTS.md; dotnet format --include <files> --no-restore --verify-no-changes; bash backend/tests/scripts/check-prompt-hashes.sh; git diff/log/show; from frontend/: npm run build, npx vitest run <spec>; jq over backend/openapi/swagger.json; NO dotnet test (named pipe SocketException 13 here: record NOT_RUNNABLE_IN_SANDBOX with the error and put the exact command in orchestrator_runs). Note: the orchestrator has ALREADY run and recorded, in docs/plans/split-ui-cycle/slice-5-evidence/round1/orchestrator-runs.md, every backend test class, the mutation probes M1-M22 (all RED), the targeted and full Replay runs, and the fix-round gates; read that file and treat its outputs as measured fact when judging F1-F6.
lens_task: Lens: FIX VERIFICATION + MUTATION. HEAD is the fix-round commit; `git diff HEAD~1` is the fix round. Read .fix-brief.txt (the adjudicated fixes F1..Fn) and .stage-report.md (the fixer's claims). For each F1..Fn: confirm the fix is present (file:line) and effective by re-introducing the original bug as a temporary mutation where feasible and recording the observed red; one `mutations` entry per fix with observed RED (verified), GREEN (not effective), NOT_RUNNABLE_IN_SANDBOX (command to orchestrator_runs), or NOT_RUN (say why). List every fix in `conformance` as SATISFIED / PARTIAL / MISSING. Then a fresh pass over the fix-round diff for regressions the fixes introduced. Restore every file you mutate.
